stepsHeadline: What happens to your car, in order

steps.title: Inspect and measure
steps.body: Paint depth on every panel under 6500K light. Repaints and thin spots get marked before we start.

steps.title: Decontaminate
steps.body: Foam wash, iron remover, clay. Salt and rail dust come off chemically, not with a scrub pad.

steps.title: Correct
steps.body: One to three polishing stages, tested on a small section first. We stop when the swirls are gone, not before.

steps.title: Coat and cure
steps.body: Panel wipe, ceramic coating, then infrared lamps and a night indoors before it sees weather.

steps.title: Hand back
steps.body: Walk-around under the light, your report, the care sheet, and the warranty with your VIN on it.

estimator.title: How long are you keeping the car?
body: That decides which coating makes sense. Paying for nine years of protection on a lease you return next spring is money in the sand.
Pick your answers. The price is the sedan price from the sheet below; trucks and SUVs are measured in person.
estimator.fine: Or 12 payments of the price ÷ 12, no interest. The inspection confirms the price before you commit.

pricing.headline: Three coatings, priced for a sedan

pricing.fine: 12 payments means full price ÷ 12, rounded down. Nothing added.

blocks.title: Twenty-two years on F/A-18s, now your Accord
body: I spent my Navy career as an aviation machinist's mate at Oceana. You learn to measure before you cut, write down what you did, and not sign for work you didn't check.
I run the shop the same way. One car at a time, one person doing it, and a sheet at the end that says what was there and what's there now.
If your paint is too thin to correct safely, I'll tell you and send you home with a wash. That happens about once a month.

faqHeadline: Questions people ask at the inspection

faq.q: Why do you measure the paint?
faq.a: Clear coat on most cars is 35 to 50 µm. Polishing removes some of it. Measuring tells us how much we can safely take and finds repainted panels before a pad does.
Yes. Salt and humidity speed up oxidation and etch bird droppings into the clear coat faster. A coating gives that a sacrificial layer to work on instead of your paint.
Any package splits into 12 equal payments, full price ÷ 12, no interest, nothing added.

faq.q: I'm military and might move. Is the warranty good?
faq.a: The warranty is tied to the car. If you PCS, any certified installer of the same coating can do the yearly check.

faq.q: How do I wash it after?
faq.a: pH-neutral soap, two buckets, no automatic car washes with brushes. The care sheet has the steps.

final.headline: Thirty minutes, a paint gauge, a real number.
final.sub: The inspection is free and you keep the readings either way.
